name: What is the average cost of a full kitchen renovation in the Berkeley/East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a full kitchen renovation in the Berkeley/East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a full kitchen renovation in the Berkeley and East Bay areas can vary widely. Factors influencing the cost include the size of your kitchen, the quality of materials chosen (e.g., custom versus semi-custom cabinets, high-end versus standard appliances), and the extent of structural or utility work. We offer detailed proposals after an initial consultation to provide an accurate estimate for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The average cost of a full kitchen renovation in the Berkeley/East Bay area varies based on size, materials, and scope of work.
